title: Fan-in of the unrolled circuit
statement: Let $M$ be a sequential Boolean circuit with combinational part $C$, and let $T$ be a nonnegative integer. If every gate of $C$ has distinct input vertices, every NOT gate of $C$ has exactly one input, and every gate of $C$ has at most two inputs, then the directed acyclic circuit obtained by unrolling $M$ through time $T$ has distinct input vertices at each gate, exactly one input at every NOT gate, and at most two inputs at every gate.
hypotheses_covered: The combinational part is well formed: each gate has distinct input vertices and each NOT gate has exactly one input
Every gate of the combinational part has at most two inputs
